name: Shop_ConfirmItemPurchase
domain: Given a list window and item window already created by a caller, checks a fixed item's price against the player's money, then (if affordable) runs a party-member selection loop that confirms or cancels the purchase for the selected unit before deducting the price and exiting.
notes: Clustered against the byte-exact Shop_SelectPartyMember template by the family scan; the retained assembly's redraw-flag/party-member-list/input-poll loop (the 'if (redraw) {...}' block, the NEW_KEYS&1 confirm / NEW_KEYS&2 cancel checks, and the REPEAT_KEYS 0x20/0x10 selection adjust) is a close structural match to the template, wrapped in an outer price-vs-money affordability gate that has no template counterpart.

Recovered from the retained owner's control flow and its literal pool, which resolves to ADDR_03001F2C (shop pointer), an undocumented u16 field at shop+0x39e (read, temporarily set to 0xe4, and restored on every exit path), the documented party_member_count (0x3a7) and party_member_ids (0x36e) fields, a price table at 0x080b4146 indexed by a signed byte read from address 0x02000240+0x11c, a money field at 0x02000240+0x118, and several undocumented shop-relative u16 fields (0xc9e, 0xca6) plus small non-shop-relative integer constants (0xcc3, 0xcc3+1, 0xca1, 0xcc5) passed directly to Func_080b0574/Func_080b04dc as message/resource ids.

Two concrete respellings measurably improved the match and are kept: (1) reordering the local declarations/initializers to the sequence the reference actually computes them in -- shop pointer, then the shop+0x39e field save, then redraw=1, then the price/money block, then unit_id=0 and selection=0 last, immediately before the affordability check -- which alone dropped wrong_instructions from 174 to 154; (2) introducing an explicit 'u8 *party_state = (u8 *)0x02000240;' local instead of writing the two SHOP_PARTY_STATE-region reads as two independent absolute-address casts. The independent-cast form let the compiler constant-fold each read into its own single absolute pc-relative load (0x0200035c and 0x02000358), which does not match the reference's shape of loading 0x02000240 once and computing both offsets from that one shared base register; the shared-pointer-variable form recovered that shape and dropped wrong_instructions to 152 with candidate_bytes moving from 468 to 472 (owner is 484).

The remaining gap has the same character as the register-bank residual found on nearby family members (080b3444, 080b29a8): the reference spills the item_window parameter straight to its stack home slot in the prologue (str r1,[sp,#8], with 'sub sp,#12' allocating the full frame up front) and keeps list_window in r9 for the whole function, while this candidate keeps item_window live in a register (r9) and puts list_window in a different register (sl), i.e. the two params are register/spill-assigned oppositely from the reference. This is consistent with the reference's true source having more simultaneously-live locals than this candidate accounts for (likely from field roles at 0xc9e/0xca6/0xca1/0xcc5 and the two unidentified Func_080b04dc message ids at the .L2 confirm-fail branch, both currently placeholder 0 in this draft) rather than a wrong control-flow shape -- the two per-iteration message ids passed to Func_080b04dc were not resolved this session and are recorded as an open gap, not a verified value.

Bounded respelling is exhausted for this session; closing the remaining ~152 wrong_instructions likely needs either resolving the two unknown Func_080b04dc message constants and the exact roles of the 0xc9e/0xca6/0xca1/0xcc5 fields against message_archive.json evidence, or a permuter-style bounded search once those are pinned down.
Exact-C adoption remains gated on an independently compiled zero-difference object.
